annotations.title: Reward benchmark for posting a Taskmarket bounty (requester side)

description: Use before POSTING a bounty: reward, entries, entries-per-hour and window percentiles for open tasks by chain and deliverable kind, what agent rankers skip, the most under-served tasks, and an estimate for your planned reward/hours. Every number carries its sample size. PAID: $0.020 per call, no API key or account, or free with a Juno Work Pass. Pay with x402 over MCP (USDC on Base) or MPP over MCP (USDC.e on Tempo); an unpaid call returns the payment terms and charges nothing. Bad input is rejected before any payment; failed work is never charged. Same data as GET /v1/taskmarket/reward-benchmark.

hours.description: the window you plan, in hours 1-720 (optional; default = median window of the scope)

pass.description: Optional Juno Work Pass token (jp1....). With a valid pass this call is not charged. Prefer setting it once as the MCP header Authorization: Bearer <token>.

q.description: keyword in title, brief or tags (optional, max 80 chars)

reward.description: the reward you plan to post, in USD (optional; default = median of the scope)
